name: HeaRTS (Health Time Series Benchmark)
description: HeaRTS is a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on health-related time series data, integrating human-in-the-loop assessment to maintain benchmark integrity over time. It assesses model capabilities in interpreting and reasoning over physiological and clinical time series signals, with human expert involvement ensuring evaluation quality as models evolve.
reputation: Emerging benchmark; notable for its explicit use of human-in-the-loop assessment to maintain integrity as AI capabilities advance.
notes: Focuses on clinical/physiological time series, a specialized and underrepresented modality in LLM evaluation. Human-in-the-loop assessment is a design feature to prevent benchmark saturation.
